## Review checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] Any scoring, odds-conversion, consensus, EV, line-shopping, or confidence-math change includes focused tests.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, API keys, invite tokens, private URLs, or personal data are included in code, logs, screenshots, or this PR.
- [ ] Documentation matches the current read-only product scope and does not imply that market-derived estimates predict outcomes.
